name: URY admin header
describe: Top bar of the URY admin app: logo, divider, breadcrumb, Ask bar, company and branch scope buttons, Open POS, notifications bell and user menu. 48px tall plus a 1px bottom border, px 24, bg-background.

Use above every admin screen (adminLayout). Arabic comes from ury/translations/ar.csv; "Plan", "Setup", the sample company, branch and department names and the sample date are translated here because ar.csv has no entry for them.
